title: Ansel and the Typewriter
author: Ada Oyelaran
blurb: Paloma Pemberton, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
